easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Everglades.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Everglades.
Repeat.
